test_MaxIoUAssigner_basic: test the MaxIoUAssigner with bboxes, gt_bboxes, and gt_labels to verify assignment results
test_MaxIoUAssigner_with_ignore: test the MaxIoUAssigner with ignore bounding boxes to verify ignored candidates get gt_ind -1
test_MaxIoUAssigner_empty_gt: test the MaxIoUAssigner with empty ground truth bboxes to verify all candidates are negative
test_MaxIoUAssigner_empty_boxes: test the MaxIoUAssigner with empty predicted bboxes to verify zero-length assignment results
test_MaxIoUAssigner_empty_boxes_and_igno: test the MaxIoUAssigner with empty predicted bboxes and ignore boxes to verify correct handling
